input.quote: The term of this Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall continue in full force and effect for an initial period of five (5) years.
input.rationale: There is no termination-for-convenience right for either party during the five-year initial term; Section 11.2 allows termination only for uncured material breach or insolvency. Absence of a Customer convenience right in a term longer than 12 months is a deviation, so we add a 30-day convenience right with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees. Helpfully, Commerce One likewise has no convenience exit, so no deletion is needed on that side.

input.quote: this Agreement shall automatically renew for subsequent one (1) year periods unless either party provides the other party with written notification at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of the initial five (5) year term or any one (1) year renewal thereof of its intention to terminate this Agreement
input.rationale: Renewal terms are 12 months with a 30-day non-renewal notice window, which meets our preferred position on both length and window. Exhibit B fixes maintenance and MarketSite access pricing for Years 2-5 "and beyond", so there is no uncapped uplift mechanic; the absence of a Vendor renewal reminder and an express CPI/3% cap is noted only.
